strategy_roster.name: HOD/LOD/PMH/PML/PDH/PDL
strategy_roster.notes: A 20-bar prior channel approximates previous-day high and low because premarket and calendar levels are unavailable. The mirrored channel serves as current-day high/low exit; 5-minute session timing is omitted.

strategy_roster.name: Volume Exhaustion
strategy_roster.entry_long: volume_ratio(volume,20) > 2 and close < open and close < sma(close,20)
strategy_roster.notes: For a long-only roster, a bearish bar below SMA(20) with volume above twice its 20-bar average selects the documented volume-exhaustion reversal. The 2*ATR protection is ATR-based rather than a percentage field, and return to the MA supplies a signal exit.

strategy_roster.name: Diff TF MA
strategy_roster.notes: SMA(20) versus SMA(50) approximates a rescaled higher-timeframe SMA against the trading series because multiple candle streams are unavailable. Both lengths and the reverse flag have no documented values; 20/50 is an explicit fallback.

strategy_roster.name: MA Reverse
strategy_roster.notes: Three consecutive closes below SMA(14) and at least 0.1% below it trigger the long reversal; thresholds 3 and 0.1% are fallbacks. Recovery above the SMA exits, while the point target is not a percentage.

strategy_roster.name: Fibonacci Auto Trend Scouter
strategy_roster.notes: A break of the prior eight-bar high with the 21-bar trend filter approximates the nested Fibonacci-extreme scout; a literal current-inclusive high comparison would be impossible. The mirrored eight-bar low supplies exit, and no stops are documented.

strategy_roster.name: Donchain Counter
strategy_roster.notes: The documented 20-candle channel is entered on an upper breakout and exited at the opposite trailing band. The 50-step activation distance, 24-hour cooldown, and stateful trailing logic are omitted.

strategy_roster.name: Fractured Fractals
strategy_roster.notes: A five-bar high breakout approximates the five-bar Williams up-fractal because fractal queues are not available; the low breakout supplies exit. Pending-order expiry, fractal hierarchy, opposite-fractal trailing, and 2% risk sizing are omitted, so 2% is not used as a stop.

strategy_roster.name: Normalized Oscillators Spider Chart
strategy_roster.notes: Normalized RSI and return momentum retain the documented 0.6/0.4 decision levels, with length 14 as a fallback. Stochastic, correlation, MFI, Williams, Aroon, and other unsupported oscillator memberships are omitted.

strategy_roster.name: Range Filter + ATR (Low Drawdown)
strategy_roster.notes: A 20-bar midpoint is an explicit fallback for the parameterless adaptive range filter, with an opposite filter cross as exit. ATR-derived stops and targets cannot be encoded as percentage fields.

strategy_roster.name: The Puncher
strategy_roster.notes: RSI(14) is oversold below 30 and 100-bar return momentum approximates slow stochastic %K below 30; simultaneous upward crosses enter. Exact stochastic smoothing and the 2000-pip stop are unavailable or not percentage-based.
